title: Maximum XOR for Each Query

monster.name: Bitwise Inverter
monster.title: Maximizer of Fixed-Bit Range XOR
monster.defeatQuote: Array of maximum k answers maximizing XOR with prefix values generated!

description: You are given a sorted array `nums` of `n` non-negative integers and an integer `maximumBit`. For each query, find `k < 2^maximumBit` such that `(nums[0] ^ ... ^ nums[last]) ^ k` is maximized. Then remove last element. Return the answers to all queries.
starterCode:
def getMaximumXor(nums: list[int], maximumBit: int) -> list[int]:
    pass
solutionCode:
def getMaximumXor(nums: list[int], maximumBit: int) -> list[int]:
    max_val = (1 << maximumBit) - 1
    curr_xor = 0
    for x in nums: curr_xor ^= x
    res = []
    for x in reversed(nums):
        res.append(curr_xor ^ max_val)
        curr_xor ^= x
    return res
hints: The optimal k is curr_xor ^ ((1 << maximumBit) - 1).
